title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி நகர்ப்புற வீட்டுவசதி திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides interest subsidy and financial grants up to Rs. 2.67 Lakhs for construction of houses to urban families belonging to EWS, LIG, and MIG categories.
eligibility_text: Urban families with annual household income up to Rs. 3.0 lakh (EWS) or Rs. 6.0 lakh (LIG) not owning a pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits_text: Upfront interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans or Rs. 1.5 Lakh direct central assistance per beneficiary.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி கிராமப்புற வீட்டுவசதி திட்டம்
description: Provides financial assistance to houseless rural families and those living in dilapidated houses for construction of pucca house.
eligibility_text: Houseless rural households and families living in zero, one or two room kutcha houses according to SECC data.
benefits_text: Financial assistance of Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/hilly states along with 90 days MGNREGA un-skilled labour.

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Scheme
title_ta: பி.எம். கிசான் விவசாயிகள் உதவித் தொகை
description: An initiative by the Government of India that provides income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families.
eligibility_text: Small and marginal landholding farmer families cultivating agricultural land with valid land records.
benefits_text: Direct cash transfer of Rs. 6,000 annually split into three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 directly into bank accounts.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி பயிர் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks.
eligibility_text: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
benefits_text: Maximum premium payable by farmers is 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops with full sum insured coverage.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
title_ta: கிசான் கடன் அட்டை திட்டம்
description: Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for agricultural and allied activities.
eligibility_text: Individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, share croppers, self help groups of farmers including animal husbandry and fisheries.
benefits_text: Concessional credit at 4% effective interest rate per annum up to loan limit of Rs. 3.0 Lakhs with collateral-free limit up to Rs. 1.6 Lakhs.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Insurance
title_ta: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் மருத்துவக் காப்பீடு
description: The largest health assurance scheme in the world, providing a health cover of Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
eligibility_text: Low income families identified under SECC 2011 registry and active ration card holders.
benefits_text: Cashless hospitalization cover of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி ஆயுள் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்
description: One-year renewable life insurance scheme offering coverage for death due to any cause.
eligibility_text: Individuals aged between 18 and 50 years having a savings bank account.
benefits_text: Life risk cover of Rs. 2,00,000 in case of death of the insured due to any reason at an annual premium of Rs. 436.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி விபத்து காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்
description: Accident insurance scheme offering risk coverage for accidental death and full/partial disability.
eligibility_text: Individuals aged between 18 and 70 years with a bank account.
benefits_text: Rs. 2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability, and Rs. 1,00,000 for permanent partial disability at Rs. 20 annual premium.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி மகப்பேறு உதவித் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers.
eligibility_text: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) for the first live birth, excluding central/state government employees.
benefits_text: Direct cash incentive of Rs. 5,000 in three installments for the first child and Rs. 6,000 for the second child if it is a girl.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
title_ta: சுகன்யா சம்ரிதி பெண் குழந்தை சேமிப்பு திட்டம்
description: Small deposit savings scheme targeted for the parents of a girl child to build a fund for her education and marriage.
eligibility_text: Girl child up to age of 10 years opened by natural or legal guardian.
benefits_text: High tax-free interest rate (8.2% p.a.) under Section 80C with partial withdrawal allowed after age 18 for higher education.

title: TN Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
title_ta: கலைஞர் மகளிர் உரிமைத் தொகைத் திட்டம்
description: Monthly cash assistance scheme for eligible female heads of households in Tamil Nadu to improve economic livelihood.
eligibility_text: Female head of household above 21 years with annual family income below Rs. 2.5 Lakhs and electricity usage under 3600 units.
benefits_text: Direct monthly bank account credit of Rs. 1,000 on the 15th of every month.

title: TN Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar)
title_ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் புதுமைப் பெண் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Higher Education
description: Higher education assurance scheme providing financial grant to girl students who studied in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
eligibility_text: Girl students who studied from Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools pursuing higher education degree/diploma.
benefits_text: Monthly cash grant of Rs. 1,000 directly credited to bank account until completion of degree or diploma.

title: TN Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme for Boys
title_ta: தமிழ் புதல்வன் திட்டம் (மாணவர் கல்வி உதவி)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Higher Education
description: Financial aid scheme for male students who studied in government schools in Tamil Nadu to pursue higher education.
eligibility_text: Boy students who completed Class 6 to 12 in TN Government schools enrolled in undergraduate degrees, ITI, or diploma courses.
benefits_text: Monthly cash grant of Rs. 1,000 directly transferred into the student's bank account to purchase books and educational materials.

title: TN Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
title_ta: முதலமைச்சரின் விரிவான மருத்துவக் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Health and Family Welfare
description: State health insurance program providing cashless medical treatment to eligible families in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Resident families in Tamil Nadu with annual income below Rs. 1,20,000 listed in smart ration cards.
benefits_text: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for 1,500+ medical and surgical procedures.

title: TN Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme

description: Nutritious breakfast program served to primary school children studying in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
eligibility_text: Children studying in Class 1 to Class 5 in Tamil Nadu Government primary schools.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
title_ta: தாழ்த்தப்பட்ட மாணவர்களுக்கான உயர்கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme assisting Scheduled Caste students to complete post-secondary education.
eligibility_text: SC category students pursuing post-matriculation courses with annual family income up to Rs. 2.5 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Compulsory non-refundable fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance ranging from Rs. 2,500 to Rs. 13,500 per annum.

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
title_ta: பழங்குடியின மாணவர்களுக்கான மெட்ரிக் முன்பருவ உதவித்தொகை
description: Supports Scheduled Tribe students studying in Class 9 and 10 to minimize dropouts.
eligibility_text: ST students studying in Class 9th or 10th in government or recognized schools with family income below Rs. 2.0 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Rs. 3,500 per annum for day scholars and Rs. 7,000 per annum for hostellers plus ad-hoc book grant.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises.
eligibility_text: Individuals above 18 years, Eighth pass for manufacturing projects above Rs. 10 Lakhs or service projects above Rs. 5 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Subsidy margin money of 15% to 35% of project cost up to Rs. 50 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs. 20 Lakhs for service sector.

eligibility_text: Unemployed youth or school/college dropouts aged 15 to 45 years with valid Aadhaar ID.
